What changed since 20 Oct

Three molecules built and adoptedOption Card in BOM and SPEC (41 instances), Stat Tile in BOM and SPEC (28), Empty State Block in BOM, Content, CFM and RN Admin (9).
RecommendationCard appeared in Hydra2017:1141. Matches the SPEC card, but has no description, no text properties and no module use. Tagged Summary Card is now an upgrade of it.
No brand-new candidatesEvery repeated block found today was already on the 19 or 20 Oct list, or is excluded.
Adoption gapsSPEC dashboard counts are still hand-built next to Stat Tile screens. BOM 1.2 shows default Option Card text.
Token driftThe RN Admin dropzone binds padding and radius to typography variables and uses a raw dashed stroke.
Old sample nodes goneBOM 5574:297524, 5585:299533, 5546:188176 and SPEC 8230:83441 no longer exist. They were replaced by the adopted molecules.

Selection Summary

A small read-only panel that repeats what the user picked (file, parts, variations) before they confirm an action.

New4 modules · 7 samples · Candidate since 19 Oct · not plannedContentPart SearchSPECBOM
Why new

Still hand-built in all four modules. No Hydra molecule covers it: Empty State Block and Stat Tile are different jobs, and Alert is a message, not a recap of a selection.

When to use vs. related

Alert tells the user something happened or went wrong. Selection Summary only repeats their own choice, so it has no icon or close. Attribute List shows many label/value pairs about one thing; Selection Summary shows one eyebrow and one or two values.

Existing Hydra molecule

none (checked the Hydra Molecules section on 28 Oct)

Destination

Hydra file → Molecules section

Choice List Row

One selectable row in a list of options (radio or checkbox), with a label, an optional second line and a trailing count.

New4 modules · 5 samples · Candidate since 19 Oct · not plannedContentPart SearchSPECBOM
Why new

Still plain frames in every module. Option Card is now built, but it is a large card for 2–4 rich choices, so it does not cover long, scannable lists. Hydra Radio and Checkbox are atoms with no row chrome.

When to use vs. related

Option Card (built): 2–4 rich choices with an icon and description, laid out as cards. Choice List Row: longer lists of named things (packages, BOMs, master SPECs), often with search or scrolling above.

Existing Hydra molecule

none (Option Card is related, not a match)

Destination

4

Outcome Summary

The result panel at the end of a long job: a title, one or two lines of explanation and a row of Stat Tiles.

New3 modules · 4 samples · Candidate since 20 Oct · not plannedBOMSPECAdmin · RN Admin
Why new

8

Tagged Summary Card → RecommendationCard

A small card with a category tag, a title, an optional description and an optional meta line or status.

Upgrade2 modules · 3 samples · Candidate since 20 Oct · now an upgrade of an existing Hydra moleculeSPECRelease Notes
Why upgrade

Since 20 Oct, Hydra has gained a RecommendationCard (2017:1141) that matches the SPEC card. It has no description and only one property (State: Rest/Hover/Resolved), and no module uses it. SPEC still uses its own local copy. Release Notes draws the same card by hand. Upgrading RecommendationCard covers both.

When to use vs. related

Option Card is a choice with an icon. FeatureCard (Hydra) is a marketing tile with a button. This card summarises one item in a list.

Existing Hydra molecule

RecommendationCard 2017:1141 (Hydra, no description, 0 module instances)

Upgrade gap

RecommendationCard today: one State property in Title Case (Rest | Hover | Resolved), no text properties, no booleans, nested Tag__Colorful / Tag / Badge__Status not exposed, no description. Needed: lower-case state values, ✏️ title / description / meta, show description / meta / status, expose the tag, add a component description.

Destination

Hydra file → Molecules section

Open questions

  • Who built RecommendationCard, and should Tagged Summary Card become its upgrade?

    It appeared in Hydra after 20 Oct with no description and no module use. I recommend upgrading it rather than building a second card.

  • Should the SPEC dashboard “Overall assessment” counts switch to Stat Tile?

    They are the only hand-built counts left next to screens that already use Stat Tile.

  • Who fixes the RN Admin dropzone bindings?

    Padding is bound to lineHeightHeading4, radius to fontSize, and the dashed stroke is a raw colour. This is a module fix, not something this audit can change.

  • BOM 1.2 Option Card text

    The second “Get started” card shows “Export to Excel / CSV”. Is that intended on 1.2, or a lost override?

  • Option Card variant count

    Molecules/index.html says 25 variants; the set has 12. Update the index, or were variants removed by mistake?

  • Draft “Frame 1” on the Empty State Block page

    Still there with BOM SKU Match Card drafts. Move it to Part Summary Card work or delete it?

  • Selection Summary success tone

    Only SPEC uses green. Keep a tone property, or make SPEC neutral?

  • Outcome Summary in RN Admin

    The bulk import result is a centred Result with Statistic atoms. Count it as a sample, or keep it on Result?

  • Part Summary Card “header” chrome

    Is the Part Search modal header the same molecule, or a modal header (organizational)?

  • Dropzone icon and button

    Bare icon and default button (SPEC), or tinted square and primary button (RN Admin)?

  • Progress Summary Bar warning tone

    Keep BOM 3.2 as a warning tone of the strip, or move it to an Alert?

  • Tagged Summary Card title weight

    Release Notes uses Large/Medium, SPEC uses Base/Normal. One size or a size property?

  • Where the Flow Doc Card should live

    Carried over from 20 Oct. Design-file utility, not product.
